analysis.summary: Vite 5.0.8 is one major-line (5 → 8) behind; the project also pins React 18 and the dashboard uses plugin-react 4.2.1, so the migration must navigate the React 19 / plugin-react upgrade that #28 performs after this. The emptyOutDir: false constraint and the esbuild pre-step for content/service-worker files are the two non-obvious constraints; both should still work on Vite 8 since the build flow keeps the dashboard entry separate. Closes F-DEP-004.
analysis.details: Current implementation: vite ^5.0.8 in devDependencies; @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.2.1; vitest ^3.2.7; build runs `node scripts/build-extension-scripts.js && vite build && node scripts/build-helper.js`. vite.config.js uses rollupOptions.input.dashboard (single dashboard entry), output.entryFileNames 'assets/[name]-[hash].js', minify 'esbuild', target 'es2022', build.emptyOutDir: false, and a '@' path alias. The extension's content-script and service-worker are produced by a separate esbuild pass into dist/ before Vite runs; the emptyOutDir: false is critical to keep those files. On Vite 7–8 the Rolldown compatibility layer is opt-in via `future: 'warn'`; if a two-step (5→7 then 7→8) is needed, the same config file works for both majors. The verify command `npm run build && npm audit` should no longer list vite ≤6.4.2. Risk: Vite 8 + plugin-react 4 may not be compatible with React 19, so the migration must land before #28. If plugin-react must move to v5, that is a separate bump — but it would still happen on this PR to keep the build green. Vite 8's behavior around `build.target` changed; the es2022 string is still accepted but worth verifying on the first CI run.

options.name: Single-step Vite 5 → 8 with @vitejs/plugin-react upgrade
options.summary: Bump vite to ^8.0.0, regenerate lockfile, raise @vitejs/plugin-react to a version compatible with both Vite 8 and React 18 (likely v4.3+ or v5 if it requires React 19), keep emptyOutDir: false and esbuild minify, run the build to confirm content-script.js / service-worker.js / dashboard all appear in dist/.
